# In side of the folder containing my fastq files
# Single-end reads
fnFs <- sort(list.files(path, pattern = ".fastq.gz", full.names = TRUE))

# Extract sample names by removing the .fastq.gz suffix
sample.names <- sapply(strsplit(basename(fnFs), ".fastq.gz"), `[`, 1)
# Sanity checks
length(fnFs)
## [1] 44
head(sample.names)
## [1] "SRR1560315" "SRR1560316" "SRR1560317" "SRR1560318" "SRR1560319"
## [6] "SRR1560320"

Inspect Quality Plots

plotQualityProfile(fnFs[1:2])
## Warning: Removed 463 rows containing missing values or values outside the scale range
## (`geom_tile()`).

Filter and Trim

Assign the filenames for the filtered fastq.gz files.

# Place filtered files in filtered/ subdirectory
filtFs <- file.path(path, "filtered", paste0(sample.names, "_filt.fastq.gz"))
names(filtFs) <- sample.names
length(filtFs)
## [1] 44
out <- filterAndTrim(fnFs, filtFs, 
                     truncLen= 400,
                     maxEE= 2, 
                     truncQ=2, 
                     rm.phix=TRUE,
                     compress=TRUE, 
                     multithread= TRUE) # On Windows set multithread=FALSE (only needed for filterAndTrim)
head(out)
##                     reads.in reads.out

## SRR1560316.fastq.gz    15386     14630
## SRR1560317.fastq.gz    13005     12487
## SRR1560318.fastq.gz    10491      9869
## SRR1560319.fastq.gz    14562     13614
## SRR1560320.fastq.gz     8262      7539

Learn Error Rates

errF <- learnErrors(filtFs, multithread=TRUE)
## 101257200 total bases in 253143 reads from 17 samples will be used for learning the error rates.
plotErrors(errF, nominalQ=TRUE)
## Warning in scale_y_log10(): log-10 transformation introduced infinite values.
## log-10 transformation introduced infinite values.

### Dereplicate

derepFs <- derepFastq(filtFs)

Sample inference - NO mergePairs step

dadaFs <- dada(derepFs, err = errF, multithread = TRUE)

Make Seq Table

seqtab <- makeSequenceTable(dadaFs)
dim(seqtab)
## [1]   44 3042

Remove chimeras

seqtab.nochim <- removeBimeraDenovo(seqtab, method = "consensus", multithread = TRUE)
dim(seqtab.nochim)
## [1]   44 2723
sum(seqtab.nochim)/sum(seqtab)
## [1] 0.9673155

Track reads through the pipeline

getN <- function(x) sum(getUniques(x))
track <- cbind(out, sapply(dadaFs, getN), rowSums(seqtab.nochim))
# If processing a single sample, remove the sapply calls: e.g. replace sapply(dadaFs, getN) with getN(dadaFs)
colnames(track) <- c("input", "filtered", "denoisedF", "nonchim")
rownames(track) <- sample.names
head(track)

https://decipher.codes/Downloads.html

Add Tax DECIPHER

dna <- DNAStringSet(getSequences(seqtab.nochim)) # Create a DNAStringSet from the ASVs
load("/home/brymoore/wsg_gtdb_tax/curated_GTDB/GTDB_r226_classifier.RData") # CHANGE TO THE PATH OF YOUR TRAINING SET
ids <- IdTaxa(dna, trainingSet, strand="both", processors=NULL, verbose=TRUE) # use all processors
## ================================================================================
## 
## Time difference of 5296.84 secs
ranks <- c("domain", "phylum", "class", "order", "family", "genus", "species") # ranks of interest
#Convert the output object of class "Taxa" to a matrix analogous to the utput from assignTaxonomy
taxid <- t(sapply(ids, function(x) {
        m <- match(ranks, x$rank)
       taxa <- x$taxon[m]
        taxa[startsWith(taxa, "unclassified_")] <- NA
        taxa
}))
colnames(taxid) <- ranks; rownames(taxid) <- getSequences(seqtab.nochim)

Write out all of the taxonomy files

Save the file with the taxonomy from using DECIPHER

write.csv(taxid, "taxid.csv", row.names = T)
write.csv(seqtab.nochim, "sequence_table.csv", row.names = T)
